Hi Aisha / Tom —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As requested, I sketched a short onboarding roadmap so we can align on the security / compliance gates that will be required to move from pilot to production. High-level asks below:

- SOC 2 Type II: provide attestation + testing window; we can accept a redacted report.
- SIG / CAIQ: ClearHarbor completes questionnaire; Redwood will return clarifying Qs and evidence requests.
- DPA: legal redline window and target signature date (we usually iterate once).
- Data retention: clarify retention windows by data class (hot cache vs. archival) and any regulatory holds (you mentioned 7 years).

Attached are a MAP template and our standard checklist (redwood-map-template.xlsx, soc2-evidence-list.pdf). Proposed mutual-action milestones:
  1) DPA redlines received (target: Mar 10)
  2) SOC 2 attestation uploaded (target: Mar 12)
  3) SIG initial return (target: Mar 16)
  4) Pilot launch (target: Mar 20)

If those targets look tight on your side please flag which dates need to move. Would you be available for a short call Mar 6 to walk through priorities?

Best,
Laura Bennett

Thanks Laura — this is helpful. A few notes from procurement/legal: 

1) SOC 2: we will need to see the full Type II attestation. Our security team requires a copy for vendor risk; a redacted copy is acceptable. Can you confirm Redwood can provide within 48 hours once requested?

2) SIG/CAIQ: we prefer to send our prioritized SIG matrix back (we have some higher-priority questions around key management and tenant isolation). Expect legal + security to add comments.

3) DPA: our legal team will do initial redlines. We typically need two weeks to turn around. Can Redwood aim to review and respond within 3 business days of receiving our redlines?

4) Retention: for certain investor-related records we have a 7-year requirement; for session/usage logs 24 months is fine but confirm whether Redwood supports configurable retention per data type.

We can do the call on Mar 6 — Tom is available in the morning (EST). I cc'd legal.

Aisha Rowe
Senior Procurement Manager, ClearHarbor Capital
aisha.rowe@clearharbor.com

Laura / team — quick feasibility check from security: 

- SOC 2 Type II: we can provide a redacted copy of our latest Type II report within 2 business days after Aisha confirms the request formally. Redactions: customer names and vendor-specific IPs; attestation and control narrative remain intact.

- SIG / CAIQ: initial auto-fill (answers pulled from our canonical control artifacts) will cover ~75-85% of the CAIQ in ~5 business days. The remaining questions typically require stakeholder input (infra, product, legal) and vendor evidence calls — full completion ~10 business days. I attached a working draft of our SIG answers (sig-answer-draft.xlsx).

- Data retention: today our default is 90 days for in-memory KV/cache, 24 months for indexed logs/backups. For a 7-year requirement we would need to enable long-term archival (cold storage) for the specific classes and add a legal hold flag. That flow is operationally supported but requires a documented scope and a one-time configuration + retention SLA addendum. Estimated lead time: 3–5 business days to configure once scope is agreed.

Recommendations:
  * Accept redacted SOC 2 now to unblock vendor risk, provide full report under NDA if requested.
  * Aim to complete the SIG initial pass within 5 business days, then schedule one or two evidence calls for the outstanding items.
  * Draft a short retention addendum covering the 7-year archival (I can provide the ops steps).

I will assign owners to each SIG section in the draft and share a tracker.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

I'll also add fallback language: if DPA is delayed beyond two weeks, sandbox-only access can proceed under a documented risk exception and approval workflow.
